subject: [PATCH v3 3/3] mm: vmscan: tell direct reclaim the allocation is ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the direct reclaim process in Linux to pass the allocation's flags down to try_to_free_pages(). Specifically, it records ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT in scan_control and uses this information to determine whether a costly order can succeed. This change is intended to improve performance by allowing direct reclaim to take advantage of free pages that are not movable or reclaimable. The patch was tested on Dev Jain's 64K mTHP benchmark and showed improved results, freeing more pages during direct reclaim with defrag_mode enabled.
